chapters.label: The cross, live
chapters.text: Stamford Bridge, November 2021. Chelsea against Burnley. Reece James has space on the right wing. He curls a cross into the box... Kai Havertz heads it in!

chapters.label: The whip
chapters.text: Watch it again. James whips it with his right foot, curling it into the gap between the keeper and the defenders.

chapters.label: Timed to perfection
chapters.text: Havertz peels off his defender, times his jump, and heads it into the bottom corner. Chelsea lead!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Look up before you cross. Then aim for the space between the keeper and the defenders, where your teammate can attack it.
